name: You are given the following quantum programming task. Implement imaginary-time e
task_prompt: You are given the following quantum programming task. Implement imaginary-time evolution classically (via scipy expm of -tau*H) to find the ground state of the 3-qubit transverse Ising model (J=0.77, h=1.17), and verify by overlapping the result with a Qiskit-exact eigenvector. Write the full runnable code (all imports included); executing it should print the results.
